<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ghosts in the Storm](/Feats.aspx?ID=4216) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Electricity" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=56" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Stance" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=152" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 25

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Add the following text to the Ghosts in the Storm impulse for Pathfinder Society play: "If the Strike is magical and already has the maximum number of property runes, the wielder can choose one to suppress to gain shock."_

</column>

---

Clouds, like eager pets, are drawn to you and to those in your good graces. Fast-moving gray clouds surround you, as well as your allies while they're in your kinetic aura. Anyone surrounded by these clouds gains a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves and [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks. When an affected creature uses a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114) action, clouds dance around it. Until the start of its next turn, it's [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4), and its Strikes gain the [_shock_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=303) rune.
name: Ghosts in the Storm
